title: Video Chat for Outdoor Painter Magazine
content: (Link to video)Here's a short video chat I did in Wyoming for Bob Bahr ofOutdoor Paintermagazine. He asked me about gouache, casein, watercolor, and our cross-country sketching adventure.Here's the painting I was working on when I did the interview.----SKB Foundation, a weeklong painting workshop in Wyoming in SeptemberOutdoor Painter article"Watercolor in the Wild"at Sellfy(Paypal) orGumroad(credit cards)
